::: {.hero}
Workforce measurement, made explicit.

OWAS is an open reference project for metric definitions, temporal data, analytical methods, and research. Its aim is to make workforce measures easier to understand, reproduce, and compare.

[Read the methodology](methodology.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}
:::

## Start with the assumptions

A number becomes useful when readers can identify who is counted, when they are counted, and which records support the result. [How to read a metric](standards/headcount/point-in-time-headcount/index.qmd) illustrates that approach.

## Project stage

This v0.1 site establishes a publishing structure. The initial metric is an illustrative public draft, not an adopted standard. [Contribute a correction or proposal](get-involved.qmd).
